newsitem.title: USA: Plains feedlot cattle market thin at $68 - trade.
newsitem.headline: Plains feedlot cattle market thin at $68 - trade.

text.p: Plains feedlot cattle markets were inactive near midday Monday, with a handful of cattle trading at $68.00 per cwt, steady with last week's top price, feedlot sources said.
About 100 head each had sold in Kansas and the Texas Panhandle/western Oklahoma area, according to private sources and USDA.
Owners were pricing the bulk of cattle at $70.00 and packers were lightly bidding $68.00.
Packers reportedly were well supplied with live cattle supplies going into the Labor Day holiday weekend.
